title: A problem with finow-q1-pro watch for dexcomg6
symptom: The user reports low capture rate with many disconnections when using a finow-q1-pro watch as a collector for a Dexcom G6, despite using the native algorithm. Additionally, a second follower (Huawei pro 30) is not connected even though it was added as a follower on the watch.
evidence_quote: The capture rate is low with alot of disconnections although iam using the native algorithm
